items.title: Language models and idea diversity: homogenisation within a session, across users, and between companies
items.summary: Ask a language model for something new and it pulls toward what everyone else would say — across companies, over long sessions, and across everyone using it. Real novelty has a shape the models do not reach for on their own.

items.title: Unverified hunches in AI-assisted software work: the certainty handoff and one-sided memory
